title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.</p> <p>We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.</p> <h2>What You'll Be Doing</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Set the strategy and roadmap</strong> for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.</li> <li><strong>Build one platform for three brands.</strong> Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.</li> <li><strong>Shape our model portfolio</strong> across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.</li> <li><strong>Make agents production-ready.</strong> Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.</li> <li><strong>Own the evaluation strategy</strong> so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.</li> <li><strong>Stay close to your customers.</strong> Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.</li> <li><strong>Lead at a senior level, </strong>&nbsp;presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Need to Thrive</h2> <p>Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:</p> <ul> <li>Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.</li> <li>A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.</li> <li>The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.</li> <li>A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.</li> <li>Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.</li> </ul> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <p>A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.</p> <h2>Why Join Us?</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Real scale from day one.</strong> Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.</li> <li><strong>Frontier work, real constraints.</strong> You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.</li> <li><strong>Visible impact.</strong> Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p>🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</p> <p>🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</p> <p>🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</p> <p>🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</p> <p>💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</p> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our <a href="https://deliveroo.engineering/">Tech Blog</a>.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire <a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/how-we-hire/">here</a>.</p> <h2>Our Global Structure</h2> <p>Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p> <h2>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</h2> <p>We know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. We’re at the heart of these industries, driving meaningful and lasting improvement.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is an incredibly important period for our Water clients.&nbsp;Following final determinations, we expect a sustained&nbsp;period of&nbsp;significant&nbsp;transformation&nbsp;set against the context of rising bills and increasing customer financial vulnerability.&nbsp;As we already work with most of these organisations, Baringa is well positioned to help Water Retailers to successfully plan for and navigate these challenges.&nbsp;</p> <p>Within our Water practice, the Water Retail and Customer Value and Affordability team supports clients to protect their most financially vulnerable customers whilst improving value across the customer lifecycle, with a focus on billing and revenue improvement, debt and affordability, and operational effectiveness in customer-facing functions.&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be leadership,&nbsp;data-driven diagnosis,&nbsp;process&nbsp;and journey improvement.&nbsp;</li> <li>Support or lead benchmarking and performance reviews, helping clients understand how they compare to peers and where to prioritise action.&nbsp;</li> <li>Take a leading role in&nbsp;customer and operational transformation programmes, supporting planning, governance, risk&nbsp;management&nbsp;and senior stakeholder engagement.&nbsp;</li> <li>Develop and apply analytical insight, including segmentation, forecasting and KPI reporting, to support better decisions and track impact.&nbsp;</li> proposals, client conversations, thought leadership or reusable assets in Water Retail and Customer Value Assurance.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will take on responsibility in line with your experience:&nbsp;&nbsp;<br> <ul> <li>as a Senior Consultant, owning end‑to‑end workstreams and managing day‑to‑day client delivery&nbsp;</li> <li>as a&nbsp;Manager&nbsp;or Senior Manager, leading workstreams or engagements, managing teams, and taking accountability for outcomes,&nbsp;quality&nbsp;and client relationships&nbsp;</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><strong>Must Haves</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience working in customer value, debt, billing, revenue&nbsp;assurance&nbsp;or affordability&nbsp;, within water retail&nbsp;&nbsp;operations, with a solid understanding of the underlying processes, common&nbsp;issues&nbsp;and levers.&nbsp;</li> <li>You’ve&nbsp;supported or delivered billing or revenue improvement initiatives, such as&nbsp;identifying&nbsp;revenue leakage, improving collections performance, or strengthening controls and governance.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience using data and analysis to diagnose problems, build insight, and support clear recommendations and decisions.&nbsp;</li> <li>You’ve&nbsp;delivered process improvement or operating model work in customer or revenue-focused functions, with an emphasis on practical, implementable change.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will have worked with a range of stakeholders across operations, finance, digital and data teams, and can communicate confidently at&nbsp;different levels&nbsp;of an organisation.&nbsp;</li> <li>You’ve&nbsp;produced clear, structured client-facing outputs, including analysis,&nbsp;slides&nbsp;or written recommendations, with strong attention to quality and narrative.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to Have</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>You’ve&nbsp;contributed to, or led parts of, customer or operational transformation programmes, with exposure to planning, governance, risk&nbsp;management&nbsp;and delivery tracking.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working alongside billing, customer relationship&nbsp;management&nbsp;or collections system change, and understand how systems and operations interact.&nbsp;</li> <li>You’ve&nbsp;contributed to proposals,&nbsp;pitches&nbsp;or internal proposition development, helping articulate client problems, solution&nbsp;approaches&nbsp;and value.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will have experience developing others through informal coaching,&nbsp;review&nbsp;or line management (expected at Manager and Senior raw.title: Support Trainer - EMEA
raw.description:
Hello!

I'm Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. 👋

As our team has grown, one of the keys to providing exceptional Support is ensuring every new hire can hit the ground running on a product with a lot of depth and nuance. Helping someone move from “just joined” to confidently helping customers takes exceptional care. We pride ourselves on delivering an onboarding experience that helps each person who joins our team be successful and, in turn, help our customers be successful.

Our onboarding program has given new hires a strong foundation. As the team continues to scale and the product keeps evolving, we know there's more to build.

That's why we're looking for one Support Trainer in AMER and one in EMEA to partner with our Training Lead and help take onboarding and ongoing training to the next level.

This role goes beyond running sessions off an existing curriculum. We're looking for someone who can dig into what's working, spot where new hires are still struggling to get up to speed, and turn that insight into better materials and better training. You'll partner closely with our Training Lead to deliver onboarding day to day, while also helping evolve the program as our product and team continue to grow.

If you're energized by joining a strong program and pushing it further, love making complex product knowledge click for new learners, and want to stay close to frontline Support work, this might be the role for you.

About This Role

As the Support Trainer, you'll design, develop, and deliver the training programs that enable the Support team to provide exceptional service. You'll work closely with Support team members and cross-functional partners to build training materials, assess where the team needs support, and ensure everyone stays current on product knowledge and best practices as we grow.

Since this function is central to how our team scales, you'll have the opportunity to build on a strong foundation, strengthen how we onboard and continuously develop our team, and create a culture where growth and knowledge-sharing are part of everyday work.

What You'll Own

Training Program Design and Delivery

  • Deliver and further develop training programs for new Support hires and ongoing team development, covering product knowledge, Support processes, internal tools, and talent acquisition-related processes.

  • Facilitate workshops, one-on-one coaching, and asynchronous learning sessions to help new team members provide a high-quality customer experience.

  • Create clear, engaging, and comprehensive training materials, including guides, videos, and tutorials.

Measuring and Improving Training

  • Collaborate with Support Leadership to assess training needs and create customized learning experiences.

  • Continuously update training materials based on product updates, new features, and feedback from the team.

  • Track the progress of trainees and provide feedback to support continuous improvement.

  • Use trainee-progress and performance data to measure the effectiveness of training initiatives, connect changes to outcomes such as ramp speed, CSAT, and QA scores, and refine the program as needed.

Staying Close to Support

  • Regularly spend time handling Support tickets to maintain continued familiarity with processes and workflows.

  • Use firsthand experience with the work to keep training grounded in what the job actually requires.

Role Requirements

  • Proven experience designing or delivering training programs within a Support or Customer Success organization, ideally in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Meaningful experience working in Support or another customer-facing technical function.

  • Experience building onboarding programs, facilitating workshops, and coaching individuals through skill development.

  • Ability to connect training outcomes to real performance and customer experience improvements, not just completion rates.

  • Strong ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, engaging, and digestible learning materials.

  • Analytical mindset for identifying skill gaps, spotting trends in performance, and iterating on programs over time.

  • Comfort working in ambiguity and building structure and process where none exists.

  • Passionate about customer experience and the role well-trained Support teams play in creating trust and loyalty.

  • Skilled at delivering constructive, actionable feedback and coaching people toward growth.

  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage learners across different styles and experience levels.

You Should Apply If:

  • You're excited about iterating on a strong program foundation and thinking creatively about enabling Support on highly technical topics.

  • You thrive on turning complex product and process knowledge into training that's clear, practical, and engaging.

  • You want to stay close to the frontline work you're training people to do, not just design programs from a distance.

  • You're data-driven and want to tie training effectiveness to real performance and customer outcomes.

  • You love coaching people and watching them grow into confident, capable support professionals.

You May Not Want to Apply If:

  • You'd rather focus solely on individual coaching than program design and materials development.

  • You prefer not to spend regular time handling Support tickets to stay connected to the work.

  • You're not interested in balancing program-building with hands-on training delivery.

  • You're uncomfortable iterating on training programs based on feedback and changing product needs.

 

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Coaching for Customer Impact — 30 min

    • Measuring Training Systems — 30 min

    • Frontline Support Partnership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation.

At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. Key Responsibilities

  • Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI.

  • Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle.

  • Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment.
  • A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies.
  • The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team.

  • Flexible Working Agreements where applicable

  • Annual Travel Card Loan & Ride to Work Scheme

  • Thursday drinks in the office and regular socials

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Design & Build AI Systems

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.
  • Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.
  • Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.
  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack

  • Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.
  • Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.
  • Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.
  • Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact

  • Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.
  • Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.
  • Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.
  • Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability

  • Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.
  • Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.
  • Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.
  • Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement

  • Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.
  • Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.
  • Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.
  • Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL

  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful

  • Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems
  • Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products
  • Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact
  • Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics

  • Product adoption and business impact
  • Performance and reliability of AI systems
  • Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
  • Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé. ⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service. En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes. 🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement. Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement. Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions. Coordonner Business Development, Customer Operations, Ops Manager et R&D. Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain. Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés. Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques. Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé. Des bases en interopérabilité, en flux de données et en FHIR. raw.title: Founding Deployment Strategist [ERP + AI]
raw.description:
TL;DR

  • We're building the SAP/NetSuite of the AI era for mid-sized companies in the real-world economy, starting with their supply chain operations (buy, sell, stock, produce)

  • Founding deployment strategist: you deploy two things into real factories, in the same project, the ERP that runs their operations, and the AI agents that work inside it. Every client goes from signed contract to go-live on the date we promised, running on Piston, with agents already doing part of the work

  • A rare shape: someone who has led client projects that landed in industrial companies, who is genuinely AI-native, and who will write the deployment playbook for the team and our system integrator partners

  • €3M Pre-seed (Top-tier VCs)

  • €45–60k + equity

What this role is (and isn't)

Most ERP deployments are people moving data around for a year. Incumbents quote six figures for it, and the client gets the same software they had, just newer. Ours run in eight to twelve weeks and deliver two things at once: a new ERP that runs buying, selling, stock and production, and AI agents inside it that read the orders, recompute the production load, prepare the purchases, and ask a human only when it matters.

This is not a product or a sales role, you are a deployment strategist. In one project, you replace a company's ERP and you put AI agents to work inside it.

Why now

Since day one, the founders have run every deployment themselves. Clients are now coming in faster than we can handle, and we need someone to own deployments. You work directly with Eric, CEO, who also leads product. That puts you as close as it gets to what success means at Piston: the success of our clients.

What you'll do

  • Deploy the ERP, with AI. The client's sales, purchasing, stock and production move onto Piston: data migrated from their old ERP and their Excel files, configuration built from their own documents, training, go-live. AI does the heavy lifting, you do the judgment.

  • Put the first AI agents live, during the ERP deployment. You decide what each agent does on its own, what it hands to a human for approval, and you make sure it's still running three months later.

  • Write the deployment playbook. Every go-live feeds a playbook that our next deployment hires and our system integrator partners will follow.

  • Map where the client's time goes. On site, you find the work that eats people's days: re-keying orders, chasing suppliers, rebuilding the same Excel every month. That map is the backlog of the next agents.

  • Teach humans to work with agents. The people you deploy with have never supervised software that acts on its own. You show them how to trust it, check it and correct it.

  • Hold the date and the budget. You size each deployment before the contract and protect that budget.

  • Use the tools engineers build for you. Our engineers build the tools that let you deploy on your own: AI-assisted data migration from the client's old ERP and Excel files, and a builder for screens and agents. You tell them what slows you down, they make it disappear.

  • Agentify your own work. On top of the tools our engineers build, you create your own agents for the deployment itself: configuration checks, test scenarios, training material, status reports. Every manual step you repeat twice becomes an agent for the next deployment.

What you bring

You bring the energy to deploy AI at scale in industrial companies. You learn fast from discovery, and you're as comfortable with founders and leadership teams as with operators on the shop floor.

Must have

  • Customer-facing project experience. Two years or more managing client projects in an industrial environment, typically in consulting (operations, supply chain, transformation). You've held deadlines, managed stakeholders, and delivered.

  • AI-native, for real. You use LLMs every day, and you've built things with them: automations, agents, prompts that run in production (Claude, GPT, n8n, Make, scripts, whatever works). You know what an agent can do alone, where it breaks, and where a human must stay in the loop.

  • Listening before configuring. You translate what people say into what the system and the agents must do, and you notice when the two don't match.

  • At ease in front of clients: Plant directors, finance, shop-floor operators. You can hold a room, and say no in it.

  • A full load, gladly. Around 150 project days a year, several deployments running at once.

  • Fluent English and French, both required. Our first clients work in French, our team writes in English, and you may support our deployments in the United States.

Nice to have

  • You've automated a real operations process end to end, with measurable hours saved

  • You've already taken a complex B2B software live

  • Comfortable with AI

  • You've worked around manufacturing or food operations: lots, BOMs, production orders, campaigns

  • Seed / Series A experience, where nobody's job description holds for long

Talent beats checklists. If you're intrigued, apply anyway.

How we'll measure success

  • ERP go-lives on the date we promised

  • Days spent against the plan we sold

  • Agents still running three months after launch, and the hours of work they take off the client's hands

What you'll get

  • €45–60k + equity

  • World-class peers

  • The first hire of our deployment team: you write the playbook that future hires and our system integrator partners will follow, and you grow with the team it builds

  • A front-row seat on how AI agents change the way real companies operate

  • Regular company offsite (2–4 times per year) in great locations

  • Ideal equipment and setup

  • Remote-first (France), about 20% of your time on client sites

Process

We value efficiency and clarity. The entire process takes no more than 2 weeks:

  1. 30-minute intro call with Florian (CRO)

  2. 60-minute deployment deep dive with Eric (CEO)

  3. 30-min cultural-fit interview with Eugène (CTO)

  4. 2 days paid assessment, on a real client situation.

  5. Offer: If it's a match, we move fast.

Interested? Tell us about a client project you led, and something you automated with AI. A short, personal note goes a long way, AI-generated cover letters don't.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h3><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h3> <p>The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence and guest-centred ethos that define Airbnb. Our mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotel partners easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.</p> <h3><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h3> <p><strong>Build a global team. Open doors no one at Airbnb has opened yet.</strong></p> <p>Airbnb Hotels is one of the most exciting growth stories in travel, and we’re only getting started. As Manager, Key Accounts, you will build and lead a brand new, globally distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers. Together you will win and onboard high-value, above-property hotel groups with hundreds of hotels across multiple continents.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>We’re looking for someone who brings:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Proven leadership of a key, strategic or enterprise accounts team</strong>, ideally globally distributed</li> <li><strong>A network and reputation in travel and hospitality</strong>, ideally hotels</li> <li><strong>Real negotiation experience </strong>with high-value partners</li> <li><strong>A builder’s mindset,</strong> with a track record of creating teams, playbooks and processes where none existed</li> <li><strong>Strong cross-functional influence</strong> across a matrix organisation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you’ll own:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>End-to-end partner management at hotel headquarter and regional office level</li> <li>Mutual account plans that drive supply and strategic relationship value</li> <li>The global Key Accounts strategy, in line with the Enterprise Team playbook</li> <li>A clear mandate to consistently exceed quarterly business KPIs</li> <li>World-class account management practices, operational excellence and partner satisfaction</li> <li>The voice of Key Accounts within Hotels leadership</li> <li>A collaborative, growth-oriented team that you mentor and motivate</li> </ul> <p>This position reports to the Global Head, Hotel Enterprise and Connectivity Partnerships, and offers a unique opportunity to shape Airbnb’s growth in the hotel market.</p> <h3><strong>Why this role:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Lead a brand new team</strong> in a business that only launched this year</li> <li><strong>Shape the Key Accounts playbook</strong> from day one</li> <li><strong>Own the relationships,</strong> the targets and the strategy for a global segment</li> <li><strong>Work with a leadership team that is moving fast </strong>and backing this business</li> </ul> <h3><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead a distributed team of Enterprise Account Managers, supporting them on partner management and new business development for supply acquisition</li> <li>Own the team’s quarterly revenue, supply acquisition and OKR targets, and ensure they are met and exceeded</li> <li>Take partners from first conversation through negotiation, signed deal and onboarding</li> <li>Develop and execute the Key Accounts option for your team where needed</li> <li>Build the operational rhythm for the team: establish and track KPIs, analyse growth and key metrics to identify trends, surface new business opportunities, and resolve business challenges with urgency</li> <li>Support the Hotels field team in achieving their goals through well-designed field-level action plans</li> <li>Work closely with Product, Technical Support, Connectivity, RevOps and Hotels Cross-Functional Leadership to drive feature adoption and business performance</li> <li>Represent Airbnb at industry and partner events, and organise internal partner events</li> <li>Hold regular team meetings, 1:1s, and performance and development reviews</li> <li>Organise team business gatherings, quarterly kick-offs and team-building events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h3> <p>Must-haves</p> <ul> <li>12+ years of professional experience and at least 8+ years in sales or account management roles in travel, hospitality or e-commerce</li> <li>6+ years of experience managing and leading high-performing teams, with a proven track record of meeting and exceeding goals</li> <li>Experience leading a globally distributed team and driving solutions to improve supply acquisition and revenue goals, ideally across international markets</li> <li>Established relationships with, or deep knowledge of, major hotel groups across the global hospitality landscape</li> <li>Entrepreneurial mindset developed from experience having launched companies, teams or significant initiatives where resources, processes and capabilities had to be created, not handed to you or followed</li> <li>Proven track record of preparing and executing complex negotiations with high-value partner organisations</li> <li>Highly motivated team builder with the ability to coach and mentor account managers</li> <li>Ability to develop a strategy, communicate it clearly, and secure buy-in and support to execute against quarterly goals</li> <li>Strong analytical skills to identify opportunities, operationalise execution with regional teams, and drive business results</li> <li>Ability to influence senior executives, both within regional Airbnb leadership and within partner leadership teams</li> <li>Ability to work within a matrix, solve problems, and influence cross-functional and cross-regional teams, with strong stakeholder management Groupe Campus, c'est une agence qui sait rester jeune au contact des étudiants !

Une agence de communication 360° spécialisée sur la cible étudiante parce qu'on est comme eux, des idées et des projets pleins la tête...

Groupe Campus, c’est aujourd’hui une équipe de 25 passionnés, déterminés à révolutionner la communication. Pour soutenir nos ambitions de croissance, nous avons besoin de renforcer rapidement les équipes.

Notre recette :

  • Ambition : Nous sommes convaincus que les limites sont faites pour être dépassées, en innovant et en osant.
  • Tous acteurs : ton impact est réel et mesurable, tu contribues directement au succès et à l'évolution de Groupe Campus.
  • Travail d'équipe : écoute, co-construction, entraide sont au cœur de notre ADN et de notre succès. Nous grandissons ensemble et partageons les mêmes objectifs en donnant du sens à notre travail.
  • Cohésion : nous aimons travailler sérieusement mais sans jamais se prendre au sérieux et nous partageons des moments de complicité intense.
  • Adaptabilité : Nous n'hésitons pas à nous remettre en cause et bousculer nos façons de faire pour constamment nous renouveler et créer. Nous sommes toujours à l'écoute de nos clients et nos collaborateurs et nous efforçons d'anticiper leurs besoins pour trouver une solution rapide et adaptée.

Nous sommes à la recherche de notre future pépite pour gérer notre réseaux DOOH.

Aujourd'hui, nous comptons déjà plus de 250 bornes d'affichage installées dans les campus étudiants à travers toute la France, et ce n'est que le début !

Vos missions :

✅ Commercial :

  • Création et développement des partenariats avec les établissements d’enseignements supérieurs pour la mise en place de bornes d’affichage digital.

✅ Gestion du parc d'affichage digital :

  • Gérer les prestataires externes et internes.
  • Supervision du déploiement et de l’installation des bornes.
  • Assurer les relations avec les écoles et les BDE :
    • Formation à l’outil d’adserving digital et suivi quotidien de l’utilisation de leurs bornes.
    • Mesure de la satisfaction et réponse aux demandes des écoles.
  • Management d’un stagiaire

✅ Gestion des campagnes DOOH :

  • Implémentation des campagnes de communication et de publicité des clients : mise en place des plans médias, suivis des lancements de campagnes, vérifications des formats et des ciblages publicitaires, conseils, bilans des campagnes media.
  • Gestion des budgets : pricing des bornes, négociation des prix avec les prestataires.

Compétences Requises :

  • Organisationnelles : Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément et à respecter les délais.
  • Relationnelles : Bon communicant(e), à l’aise avec des interlocuteurs variés (prestataires, écoles, clients).
  • Créatives : Capacité à proposer des idées pour améliorer les contenus et les partenariats.
  • Autonomie : Capacité à travailler de manière proactive et être réactif.
  • Esprit commercial : Aptitude à détecter des opportunités, négocier avec efficacité et atteindre les objectifs fixés

raw.title: Signalling Security Specialist
raw.description:
About the Role

As a Telecom Signalling Security Analyst, you will combine customer-facing delivery with hands-on technical execution in sensitive telecom environments.

You will:

  • Support and operate P1 Security solutions in production contexts (notably PTM and VKB).
  • Conduct signalling security audits using proprietary tooling (notably PTA) and deliver rigorous, professional reports and presentations to customers.

This is a profile-focused role: we are looking for someone who can cover both audit delivery and operational support.

Our teams are remote-first, with a preference for candidates who can overlap working hours with Central European Time.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer delivery & communication

  • Act as a technical point of contact for customers: scoping, updates, and delivery.

  • Deliver presentations, training, and debrief sessions.

  • Signalling Security Audits (PTA)

  • Contribute to audit scoping (objectives, perimeter, constraints, timelines, deliverables).

  • Prepare safe execution plans and operational safeguards.

  • Execute signalling security audits using PTA and associated tooling in a controlled manner.

  • Analyze results, validate findings, and assess exploitability/root cause.

  • Draft professional technical reports in English and present findings to customers.

  • PTM operations & IT support (ticket management)

  • Provide IT support for the PTM IDS in the context of customer ticket workflows.

  • Troubleshoot and maintain PTM deployments, including Linux and virtualization layers.

  • Operate and improve day-to-day tooling/scripts used for investigations, maintenance, and deployments.

  • Collaboration & continuous improvement

  • Work closely with Engineering and R&D to improve tooling, detection quality, and operational processes.

  • Maintain clear internal documentation and handover notes.

Requirements

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Technical writing (English): ability to draft professional, structured technical reports and slide decks

  • Client communication: strong verbal communication skills for presenting and interacting directly with customers.

  • Telecom core & roaming security: solid understanding of telecom core architecture, roaming concepts, and where signalling security fits in real operator environments.

  • Signalling protocols & call flows (hands-on): ability to read and reason about SS7/SIGTRAN, Diameter, LTE/IMS and GTP-C call flows, and connect traces/observations to concrete security findings.

  • Standards-driven audit mindset: familiarity with GSMA Fraud & Security standards (notably FS.11, FS.19, FS.20) and ability to translate requirements into test cases, evidence collection, and actionable remediation.

  • Roaming signalling security: mastery of roaming signalling attacks and call flows.

  • Linux / terminal: comfortable using a terminal and basic Linux commands.

  • Scripting

  • Python: Proficiency in "quick scripting" mode : Ability to develop one-off analysis or testing scripts. No expectations regarding software architecture or code maintainability

  • Bash / shell scripting: ability to write and maintain scripts for operational needs.

  • Virtualization / operations: experience with Linux + ESXi / VM operations (deployment, troubleshooting, maintenance) is a plus

  • Soft skills: customer centered, autonomy, high level of rigor, proactive mindset (ability to propose solutions).

Hiring Process

  1. Initial contact call (10–20 minutes)
  2. Call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)
  3. Capability assessment (role-specific exercise)
  4. Final interview with C-Level and directors (30 minutes)

The Order Taking squad owns core ordering experiences within SumUp's Point of Sale app, including the shopping bag, checkout, the catalog experience within ordering, open orders, table management and printer integrations. These capabilities help thousands of hospitality merchants manage orders reliably during daily service.

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you'll build new hospitality workflows and evolve established ordering experiences across iOS and Android. You'll work with SwiftUI on the platform-specific UI and contribute to shared Kotlin Multiplatform business logic. The role involves complex mobile engineering across multi-device synchronisation, shared order state and a large, established application.

You'll join a small, experienced and fast-moving squad that works collaboratively through technical refinement, code reviews and pair programming. The team values engineers who communicate directly, challenge assumptions and proactively shape solutions rather than simply execute predefined tasks.

  • Design and build new ordering experiences in SwiftUI, while evolving established capabilities such as table management, kitchen workflows and printer integrations

  • Collaborate closely with Android engineers and platform teams to maintain consistent cross-platform behaviour and reliable multi-device order synchronisation
  • Take part in code reviews, pair programming and collaborative testing to maintain a high quality bar
  • Help refine and scope upcoming work, bringing technical judgement to product and architectural trade-offs
  • Contribute to Mobile Chapter and KMP platform initiatives across the wider POS tribe

  • 5+ years of experience building production iOS applications in Swift, with strong SwiftUI knowledge
  • Experience working in a large, established codebase and making pragmatic improvements without requiring a full rewrite

title: Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing - alternance
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. Pourquoi Deliveroo ? Lorsque l'on vous dit Deliveroo, vous imaginez sans doute d'abord les bons petits plats livrés chez vous en moins d'une demi-heure. Plutôt sympa non ? Mais c'est en coulisses que l'histoire est la plus intéressante. Nous opérons désormais à travers le monde et travaillons avec plus de 176 000 restaurants partenaires et commerces en tous genres en France. Nous collaborons avec des milliers de livreurs et de livreuses partenaires pour le plus grand bonheur de nos millions de personnes clientes. Nous recherchons un·e Assistant·e Chef de Projet Marketing Merchant en alternance pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à Paris, pour une durée de 12 mois. Aux côtés de l'équipe Merchant, vous contribuerez au développement de la croissance de nos partenaires, au déploiement de nos campagnes nationales 360° et en accompagnerez des projets à fort impact sur l'acquisition, la rétention et la fidélisation de nos restaurants partenaires. Descriptif du poste : En tant qu'Apprenti(e) dans l'équipe Marketing Merchant Restaurant, vous travaillerez au quotidien avec l'équipe marketing chargée de mettre en avant toute la sélection de restaurants et de partenaires de Deliveroo. Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir régulièrement avec les autres départements marketing tels que l'équipe média, l'équipe créative, le CRM ainsi qu'avec l' équipe commerciale.  Vos missions consisteront à: Mettre en avant sur l'application les restaurants et partenaires disponibles sur l'app. Soutenir l'équipe commerciale dans la création et l'exécution de plans marketing destinés à mettre en avant les partenaires présents sur Deliveroo.   Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe commerciale et les équipes marketing transversales (marque, réseaux sociaux, CRM et influenceurs) pour développer et exécuter des plans partenaires basés sur les priorités commerciales (par exemple, objectifs régionaux, accords d'exclusivité, renégociations). Préparer des présentations et des supports pour appuyer les discussions de l'équipe commerciale avec les partenaires, en veillant à l'alignement et à la clarté. Contribuer à l'exécution des points forts des partenaires en collaboration avec le CRM et le Commercial (communications mensuelles d'exclusivité / bannières dédiées sur l'application / notifications push...). Gérer le budget alloué pour le plan de chaque partenaire, en optimisant les ressources locales pour obtenir un impact maximal.  Analyser l'impact de nos campagnes pour en tirer des recommandations pour les équipes commerciales Cette alternance vous permettra d'appréhender de nombreux sujets marketing (création de campagne, analyse, sensibilité client) et vous permettra d'acquérir une bonne connaissance des enjeux marketing et de la gestion de projets complexes grâce à la collaboration transverse que vous aurez avec les autres pôles.  Ce qui vous permettra de réussir Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de commerce, université ou équivalent, avec une spécialisation en marketing, communication ou digital et recherchez une alternance d'une durée d'un an à partir de Décembre 2026 / Janvier 2027. Vous Vous Reconnaissez Dans Les Points Suivants Vous êtes organisé·e, rigoureux·se et savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle en respectant les délais Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale en français ainsi qu'un bon niveau d'anglais. Vous êtes à l'aise avec les chiffres et aimez analyser les performances pour en tirer des recommandations. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et la coordination de nombreux interlocuteurs. Vous êtes curieux·se, proactif·ve et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance. Voici un lien avec de la documentation pour vous préparer aux entretiens. Nous offrons un environnement de travail dynamique et stimulant, où vous aurez l'opportunité de développer vos compétences et de contribuer activement à notre mission. Rejoignez notre équipe exceptionnelle dès maintenant et faites partie de cette aventure passionnante ! La vie chez Deliveroo : Notre équipe est en forte croissance, notre impact très important, et nous cherchons à répondre aux questions les plus stimulantes du moment. Nous progressons rapidement, nous explorons toujours de nouvelles idées et nous sommes très transparents quant aux décisions que nous prenons et à ce qui motive nos choix. Il y a tellement de questions que nous souhaitons résoudre, et encore plus que nous n'avons pas encore rencontrées. Comment les données et la technologie peuvent-elles aider les restaurants à développer leur activité à mesure que les habitudes des consommateurs évoluent ? Comment pouvons-nous prédire ce qu'une personne souhaitera pour dîner avant même que l'idée ne lui vienne à l'esprit ? Chez Deliveroo, ces questions ne sont que quelques-uns des défis ambitieux auxquels nous nous efforçons de répondre – et il n'y a aucun projet qui ne peut pas devenir le vôtre. Aucune solution n'appartient à une équipe en particulier, ce qui vous ouvre d'extraordinaires possibilités en termes de développement et d'impact personnel. À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l'article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité professionnelle, l'emploi des personnes en situation de handicap. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience. If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you! Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness . description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>Information about the position&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Vinted Go grows by signing new pick-up/drop-off locations, and a large share of that growth is delivered by external sales agencies. You will own that network: the agencies running our field sales, virtual calling and digital outreach across Europe and the US.</p> <p>Today these relationships are managed in a fragmented way. Your job is to turn them into one well-governed, high-performing extension of the acquisition team, with clear targets, a consistent operating rhythm and a single point of accountability.</p> <p>This is a high-ownership role. You will act as an agency manager, performance analyst and budget owner, and above all as the guardian of the Vinted Go sales approach in every conversation an agency has on our behalf. title: Administrateur de Systèmes Applicatifs EDI H/F
description: Dans un contexte de croissance de l’activité EDI et de remplacement, nous recherchons un(e) Administrateur de systèmes applicatifs EDI F/H pour participer à la maintenance, à l’exploitation et à l’évolution d’une plateforme d’échanges de données utilisée par plusieurs centaines de clients. Le poste est rattaché à l’équipe EDI, sous la responsabilité d’un manager également chef de projet. Votre objectif Votre rôle consistera à veiller au bon fonctionnement de la plateforme EDI, résoudre les problèmes techniques et participer à son évolution. Vous interviendrez sur la supervision des flux EDI, la résolution des incidents et l’intégration de nouveaux clients et partenaires, tout en apportant des solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins rencontrés. Vous participerez également à l’évolution des outils internes, notamment à travers l’intégration de nouvelles fonctionnalités liées à l’intelligence artificielle. L’équipe que vous rejoignez Vous intégrerez une entreprise à taille humaine, dont une équipe EDI. Vous évoluerez au contact de profils techniques expérimentés, dans un environnement où la qualité de service, la réactivité et la proximité avec les clients occupent une place importante. Une formation en immersion avec un chef de projet est prévue pour vous familiariser avec les standards EDI, les protocoles et les outils internes. Ce que vous ferez concrètement Au quotidien, vous interviendrez principalement sur : Assurer l’exploitation, la supervision et la maintenance opérationnelle de la plateforme EDI. Analyser et résoudre les incidents techniques signalés par les outils de supervision ou les clients. Configurer et maintenir les échanges de données entre les différents systèmes informatiques. Intégrer de nouveaux clients et partenaires en mettant en place les connexions et les flux EDI. Intervenir sur les applications et les scripts nécessaires au traitement et à la transmission des données. Assurer le support technique auprès des clients. Vous pourrez également contribuer à : Participer à l’évolution des applications et des outils internes. Contribuer à l’intégration de fonctionnalités d’intelligence artificielle dans les solutions existantes. Améliorer les traitements et les processus d’échanges de données. Participer à la résolution de problématiques liées aux réseaux, aux systèmes et à la sécurisation des échanges. Votre environnement technique Pour être rapidement à l’aise sur le poste, une connaissance opérationnelle des échanges EDI, notamment du standard EDIFACT, ainsi qu’une bonne maîtrise des environnements Linux sont attendues. Vous pourrez notamment évoluer avec : EDI / EDIFACT : standards et formats d’échanges de données. Linux / Shell / Bash : administration, scripting et automatisation. PHP : développement et maintenance applicative. SQL : manipulation et exploitation des bases de données. OFTP / OFTP2 / AS2 / X400 / SFTP : protocoles de communication et de transmission. XML / XSLT : traitement et transformation des données. De bonnes connaissances en réseaux informatiques, systèmes et cryptographie vous permettront d’avoir une compréhension globale des échanges et de leur sécurisation., Vous rejoindrez un environnement où vous pourrez développer vos compétences sur différentes technologies et évoluer progressivement vers davantage de responsabilités techniques. Votre profil Vous disposez d’au moins 1 an d’expérience professionnelle, idéalement dans l’exploitation, l’intégration ou l’administration de systèmes EDI. Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des flux EDI et des messages au format EDIFACT, et vous comprenez les problématiques liées à leur traitement, leur transmission et leur supervision. Vous maîtrisez les environnements Linux et Shell/Bash, possédez des connaissances en PHP et êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données SQL. Une expérience dans le support applicatif, la résolution d’incidents ou l’intégration de nouveaux flux de données sera particulièrement pertinente. Une connaissance des protocoles de communication EDI et des technologies XML / XSLT constituera un atout supplémentaire. Vous disposez également d’un bon niveau de communication en français, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, ainsi que d’un anglais professionnel. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
