title: Energetic Materials Scientist (Munitions)
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Energetic Materials Engineer in the Warhead team, you will be the technical authority ensuring the energetic materials in our systems are properly selected, tested and qualified for their intended use. You will build Harmattan AI’s expertise in energetic materials chemistry, stability and supplier assurance, so we can safely and repeatedly source and produce energetics as we scale. You will work daily with systems, warhead and fuze engineers, as well as test facilities and partners. Responsibilities Act as the internal reference on energetic materials chemistry, properties and compatibility to guide material selection. Baseline the energetic materials requirements and material inventory across our products. Evaluate chemical stability, ageing and environmental sensitivity to define safe-for-use, storage and operational requirements. Develop and oversee material qualification in line with NATO standards, internally and with external partners. Run hands-on material characterization and build the laboratory capability, in-house or through partners, to support it. Assess supplier specifications, process capability and quality requirements to ensure repeatability and traceability, and manage inspections and non-conformances. Support warhead and fuze engineers in sourcing and preparing materials for prototype testing, and report results to systems engineers. Build qualification frameworks and guidance for the wider team, and contribute to growing an internal materials team. Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based out of the EMEA territory, specifically Switzerland/Zurich/Geneva.

 

Regional Expectations

  • Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus.

 

German Language Expectations

  • Native-level or full professional fluency in German (written and spoken), with the ability to conduct complex sales conversations and negotiations.

 

Opportunity

Deepgram is looking for an Account Executive to drive new customers and revenue to our rapidly growing company, specifically in the German markets. You will have the opportunity to sell a patented world-class voice AI platform that has been enabling our customers to achieve things previously not attainable. We are looking for hungry and talented sales professionals to help us take our top-line revenue to new heights!

 

What You'll Do

  • Self-prospecting to build a strong sales pipeline of new logos, striving to exceed quarterly and annual sales targets, as well as partnering with the Marketing and SDR teams to generate meetings

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (especially Sales Ops and Sales Engineers) to ensure sales effectiveness

  • Have a depth of understanding regarding customer needs in the voice AI space, competition, and Deepgram products to be able to articulate Deepgram’s value proposition fully to highly technical buyers

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, work with CSMs to drive upsell opportunities and manage existing accounts ongoing

You’ll Love This Role If You

  • Value having leadership that has tenure and a track record of success

  • Thrive working with A Players as cross-functional partners across GTM

  • Understand the importance of selling a product that is market validated and can deliver on its technical promise

  • Believe there should be no cap to upside and want control of account up-sell potential

  • Are passionate about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • Proven experience in a technical full-cycle sales role

  • Experience building your own pipeline from scratch and closing accounts

  • Consistent overachievement against sales targets in past experiences

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Empathy and a unique ability to understand customer needs

  • Highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills due to managing multiple opportunities at any given time

  • Ability to drive a consistent and repeatable sales process with a coachable/adaptable mindset based on other rep success.

  • It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Familiarity with Challenger or Triangle sales methodology

  • Experience selling to a technical audience in a similar space

  • Experience selling developer tools, infrastructure, or AI/ML technologies.

  • Fluency in German, French, Dutch, or other major regional languages.

title: Senior Director, Patient Advocacy & Communications Lead, EMEA
description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.   Summary of Position: The Patient Advocacy & Corporate Communications Lead, EMEA will be responsible for developing and executing integrated patient advocacy and communications strategies that advance the company's mission, strengthen stakeholder trust, and support business objectives across the region, starting with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and including  facioscapulohumeral dystrophy (FSHD) in line with clinical development milestones.  This role will serve as the primary EMEA lead for patient advocacy engagement while also driving corporate and product communications, executive visibility, disease awareness initiatives, and internal communications. The successful candidate will engage the SMA community (and communities for future disease states) to establish and solidify trust and act as a connector to patient and advocate perspectives to drive Scholar Rock’s patient first values. They will act as a trusted strategic advisor to regional leadership and work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Global patient advocacy and communications, Market Access, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Commercial Teams, supported by global and regional agency partners. The ideal candidate combines deep understanding of the rare disease community with exceptional communications and stakeholder management capabilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial biotech environment.       Position Responsibilities  Patient Advocacy Leadership Develop and Execute Advocacy Strategy Contribute to the development and implementation of a comprehensive EMEA patient advocacy strategy aligned with corporate and regional objectives, starting in the SMA community and building the FSHD relationships. Ensure patient and caregiver perspectives are appropriately incorporated throughout the product lifecycle, from clinical development through commercialization. Identify emerging opportunities and risks within the advocacy and policy environment and provide strategic recommendations to leadership. Foster a patient-centric culture throughout the organization. Build Meaningful Community Partnerships Establish and maintain authentic, trusted relationships with regional and national patient organizations, advocacy leaders, caregivers, and community stakeholders. Serve as the primary company representative to patient advocacy organizations associated with direct-to-market counties throughout EMEA Support development of and monitor execution against a patient advocacy group engagement playbook for partner market countries ensuring advocate engagement follows Scholar Rock standards Identify, deliver, and participate in collaborative initiatives that support disease awareness, education, research, access, and policy priorities. Build long-term collaboration based on transparency, trust, and shared goals. Generate Patient Insights  Execute patient advisory boards, caregiver councils, listening sessions, and community engagement initiatives. Collect and translate patient insights into actionable recommendations for internal teams. Partner with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, and Market Access to ensure the patient voice informs strategic decision-making. Drive initiatives that better understand the patient and caregiver journey across EMEA markets. Corporate Communications Leadership Corporate Reputation & Narrative  Develop and execute a comprehensive EMEA communications strategy that enhances company reputation and stakeholder trust. Shape and implement compelling corporate narratives that articulate the company's mission, vision, scientific innovation, and commitment to patients. Ensure consistency of messaging and brand positioning across all EMEA communications activities. Support the development of disease area leadership and corporate positioning strategies. Media & External Communications Manage regional media relations and proactive communications opportunities. Draft and oversee press releases, corporate announcements, leadership messaging, Q&A documents, and stakeholder communications aligned with relevant global advocacy and communications plans Support major corporate and product milestones and drive the regional comunication plans of key milestones, including regulatory decisions, clinical data presentations, launch activities, and access achievements. Develop digital communications strategies and manage relevant corporate channels aligned with Global Communications plans Monitor emerging issues and develop proactive communications plans and response strategies. Executive Communications & Thought Leadership Partner with senior leaders to enhance visibility and thought leadership within the rare disease community. Develop executive presentations, conference materials, speeches, articles, and strategic messaging. Support participation at patient, scientific, industry, and policy events across EMEA. Position company leaders as credible and trusted voices within the neuromuscular disease ecosystem. Internal Communications Develop internal communication strategies that foster employee engagement and organizational alignment. Support communications related to business updates, organizational initiatives, and company milestones. Reinforce company culture and mission through effective storytelling and employee engagement programs. Ensure employees remain connected to the needs and experiences of patients and caregivers. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate closely with Global Advocacy and Communications, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Development Teams. Act as a strategic partner across functions to align patient advocacy and communications initiatives with broader business priorities. Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulations, industry codes, and company policies. Provide patient engagement and communications expertise to internal stakeholders and project teams. Candidate Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree required. Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Communications, Public Affairs, Public Health, Healthcare Management, or related field preferred. Experience 8-12+ years of relevant experience within biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or rare diseases. Significant experience in patient advocacy, corporate communications, public affairs, or stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated success working with patient organizations and advocacy communities. Experience supporting products in development, launch, or commercialization preferred. Strong understanding of the rare disease landscape and European healthcare environment. Experience working across multiple European countries and stakeholder groups. Core Competencies Patient-Centric Leadership Passion for improving the lives of patients and caregivers. Ability to build trusted and compliance relationships based on empathy, authenticity, and credibility. Strategic Thinking Ability to connect advocacy and communications initiatives to broader business goals. Strong judgment and ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments. Influencing & Collaboration Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence without authority and work effectively across functions. Communication Excellence Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation skills. Ability to translate complex scientific and business topics into clear and compelling messages. Agility & Execution Comfortable operating in a growing biotech environment where strategic thinking and hands-on execution are equally important. Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive results with limited resources. What Success Looks Like Within the first 12-24 months, the successful candidate will: Implement an integrated multi-channel advocacy and communications plan for priority markets Establish the company as a trusted partner within the EMEA rare neuromuscular disease community, starting with SMA. Build a sustainable network of patient advocacy partnerships across key markets. Create a structured process for incorporating patient insights into business decisions.   • Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues.

  • Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions.

Deliver High-Quality Technical Support

  • Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer.

  • Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases.

  • Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents.

  • Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team.

Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function

  • Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale.

  • Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact.

  • Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as:

    • Incident response and resolution times

    • Support response and resolution times

    • Alert quality and monitoring coverage

    • Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models.

Surface Operational and Customer Insights

  • Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data.

  • Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized.

  • Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction.

Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience

  • Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact.

  • Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise.

  • Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function

  • Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team.

  • Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication.

  • Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness.

  • Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English.

  • Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems.

  • Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies).

  • Experience operating or supporting distributed infrastructure or network-based systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.

  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers.

  • Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis.

  • Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

How We Show Up Every Day

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

Operating Principles

title: Sr Talent & People Partner
description: Über Rivia Rivia ist ein Technologieunternehmen, das eine Datenplattform entwickelt, die die Zukunft der klinischen Studienanalyse prägt. Rivia wurde aus der Überzeugung heraus gegründet, dass sich neue Medikamente mit einem Bruchteil des heutigen Kapitals erfolgreicher auf den Markt bringen lassen. Biotech-Unternehmen sind die wichtigste Quelle therapeutischer Innovationen. Ihre klinische Entwicklung wird jedoch immer wieder durch fragmentierte Daten und veraltete Werkzeuge ausgebremst. Rivia führt klinische Studiendaten in großem Maßstab zusammen. Das Herzstück ist eine wiederverwendbare intelligente Datenplattform mit Hunderten von Konfigurationen und studienspezifischen Logiken, die unabhängig von der Struktur der Quelldaten funktioniert. Diese vertikal integrierte Kombination aus Datenplattform, Workflows und KI-Agenten schafft einen entscheidenden Vorteil bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien. In den vergangenen zwei Jahren haben Biotech-Unternehmen aus Europa und den USA, die mit Rivia weltweit klinische Studien durchführen, messbare Ergebnisse erzielt: von einem früheren Verständnis des therapeutischen Potenzials bis hin zu deutlich effizienteren Studienabläufen. Im März 2026 nahm Rivia in einer Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde 15 Millionen US-Dollar auf, angeführt von Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia will zur Standardinfrastruktur für die moderne Arzneimittelentwicklung werden und die Durchführung klinischer Studien von Anfang bis Ende grundlegend verändern. Die Rolle Als Senior Talent & People Partner bist du die erste Verstärkung im People-Team von Rivia. Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs baust du die Funktion von Grund auf auf und entwickelst sie weiter. Du verantwortest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess und wächst zugleich in weitere People-Themen hinein: Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklung, Performance, Unternehmenskultur, Organisationsgestaltung und Personalprozesse. Die Position bietet erfahrenen Recruiter:innen die Möglichkeit, den nächsten Schritt in eine umfassendere People-Rolle zu machen. Ein fertiges HR-Handbuch, das du einfach übernimmst, gibt es nicht. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Prozesse, lösen neue Herausforderungen, probieren Ideen aus und schaffen die Grundlagen für das Wachstum von Rivia. Durch praktische Verantwortung, enge Zusammenarbeit und Einblicke in strategische Entscheidungen wie auch operative Herausforderungen lernst du direkt von der Leitung des People-Bereichs. Du bist die enge Sparringspartner:in der Leitung des People-Bereichs: Du denkst selbstständig, arbeitest vertrauensvoll zusammen und packst mit an. Du bringst Ideen ein, hinterfragst Annahmen, handelst schnell und setzt Vorhaben konsequent um. Gesucht ist jemand, der versteht, wie People-Arbeit zum Geschäftserfolg beiträgt, und Führungskräfte wirklich beraten möchte – statt lediglich Prozesse abzuarbeiten. Was dich begeistert Du liebst Recruiting, möchtest dich aber über Talent Acquisition hinaus weiterentwickeln und das gesamte People-Spektrum kennenlernen. Die erste Person im People-Team zu sein und alles von Grund auf mit aufzubauen, reizt dich mehr, als ein bestehendes Handbuch zu pflegen. Du arbeitest eng mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs zusammen, hinterfragst Ideen und lernst durch echte Verantwortung. Du findest außergewöhnliche Talente und baust vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften mit den einstellenden Führungskräften auf. Du löst komplexe Geschäfts- und People-Fragen schnell, neugierig und pragmatisch. Du möchtest die Mitarbeitererfahrung, Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und Zusammenarbeit verbessern. Du ergreifst die Initiative, behältst verschiedene Prioritäten im Blick und siehst direkt, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Deine Aufgaben Talent Acquisition Du verantwortest den gesamten Einstellungsprozess über alle Teams hinweg – von der Definition der Rolle über Talent Mapping, Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Betreuung der Kandidat:innen bis hin zu Angeboten und Vertragsabschlüssen. Du berätst einstellende Führungskräfte fundiert zu Recruiting-Strategie, Marktbedingungen, Qualität der Kandidat:innen und möglichen Kompromissen. Du baust proaktiv Talent-Pipelines auf und sorgst für eine wertschätzende, verlässliche Candidate Experience. Du verbesserst Recruiting-Prozesse, ATS-Workflows, Reporting und Recruiting-Analysen. Mitarbeitererfahrung und Entwicklung Gemeinsam mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs entwickelst du Onboarding, Mitarbeitererfahrung, Engagement, Unternehmenskultur und Entwicklungsinitiativen weiter. Du unterstützt die Einführung von Performance Reviews, Feedback-Praktiken, Karriereentwicklung und Angeboten für Führungskräfte. Du hörst den Anliegen von Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften zu, erkennst Reibungspunkte und setzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Verbesserungen um. People Operations und Business-Partnerschaft Du hilfst dabei, skalierbare People-Prozesse, Richtlinien, Systeme und Abläufe entlang des gesamten Beschäftigungsverhältnisses von Grund auf aufzubauen. Du unterstützt Führungskräfte mit pragmatischer, geschäftsorientierter Beratung und durchdachten Personalentscheidungen. Mit wachsendem Verantwortungsbereich arbeitest du an Projekten zu Organisationsgestaltung, Vergütung, HR Operations und People Analytics mit. Du erkennst Probleme früh, schlägst Lösungen vor und kümmerst dich um deren Umsetzung, statt auf Anweisungen zu warten. Was du mitbringst Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Umfassende Erfahrung im Recruiting über den gesamten Einstellungsprozess hinweg sowie nachweisbare Erfolge bei der eigenständigen Besetzung anspruchsvoller Positionen. Den Wunsch, dich in eine umfassendere People-Rolle weiterzuentwickeln; Erfahrung als HR-Generalist:in ist nicht erforderlich. Du baust gern Neues auf, löst Probleme, handelst schnell, denkst kritisch und übernimmst Verantwortung bis zur Umsetzung. Geschäftssinn und die Sicherheit, einstellende Führungskräfte und andere Verantwortliche zu hinterfragen, zu überzeugen und zu beraten. Du fühlst dich wohl mit offenen Fragestellungen, hohen Erwartungen, mehreren parallelen Prioritäten und praktischer Arbeit. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, gutes Urteilsvermögen, Organisationstalent und Erfahrung im Stakeholder-Management. Neugier, Bescheidenheit und die Bereitschaft, neue People-Fachgebiete zu erschließen. Von Vorteil Kenntnisse des Schweizer Arbeitsrechts. Einblicke in Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Performance Management oder Mitarbeiterengagement. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder Scale-up sowie Vertrautheit mit ATS-, HRIS- oder People-Analytics-Systemen. Bewerbungsprozess Unser Bewerbungsprozess dauert in der Regel zwei bis vier Wochen und umfasst vier Schritte: Kennenlernen: 30-minütiges erstes Gespräch mit dem People-Team. Vertiefendes Gespräch: Austausch mit der Leitung des People-Bereichs über Recruiting, Business-Partnerschaft und deine Entwicklungsziele. Praxisaufgabe: Gemeinsame Bearbeitung einer realistischen Recruiting- und People-Herausforderung. Kennenlernen des Teams: Gespräche vor Ort in Zürich, um herauszufinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen. Unsere Werte Bei Rivia setzen wir auf Spitzenleistung, kontinuierliches Lernen und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen und unseres Teams. Mit vollem Einsatz gewinnen: Herausforderungen mit Entschlossenheit, Ausdauer und Tatkraft angehen. Veränderung annehmen: Wandel als Chance zur Verbesserung sehen. Warum eigentlich nicht?: Annahmen hinterfragen und neugierig bleiben. Lücken erkennen: Probleme frühzeitig identifizieren und lösen. Gemeinsam Verantwortung übernehmen: Zusammen für Ergebnisse einstehen und einander unterstützen. Lösungen mit Mehrwert schaffen: Sinnvolle Ergebnisse erzielen, die wirklich etwas bewirken. About the role

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.

  • Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.

  • Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.

  • Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.

  • Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.

  • Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

 

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.

  • Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

    • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP: REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).

    • NetSuite: SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.

    • JD Edwards EnterpriseOne: AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.

  • A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.

  • Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.

  • A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).

  • Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).

  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.

  • Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

 

Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer

We hire at both levels. Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

Integration Engineer

  • Years: 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.

  • Coaching: you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.

  • Scope: you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

Senior Integration Engineer

  • Years: 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.

  • Breadth: integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Coaching: you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.

  • Scope: you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

Why BLP

  • Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.

  • Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.

  • Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

title: Business Development Representative
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before. As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings. This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle. What you'll do: Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us. Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts. Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.). Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team. Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand. Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance. Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets. Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day. We'd love to hear from you if you are: Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone. Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results. Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different. Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets. See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value. Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity. Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity. Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft. Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social. Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Our Values Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” Why you’ll love working at Paddle We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on&nbsp;the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory,&nbsp;you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. Your work will span model internals,&nbsp;quantization and model compression, speculative decoding, KV-cache optimization,&nbsp;inference engines, serving architecture, and&nbsp;benchmarking to improve&nbsp;latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, and cost per token while&nbsp;preserving&nbsp;quality and reliability.</p> <p>You&nbsp;will work with kernel and platform&nbsp;engineers to investigate serving problems, compare configurations, and&nbsp;resolve performance and quality&nbsp;regressions. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through&nbsp;reproducible benchmarks and safe production&nbsp;rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization&nbsp;projects&nbsp;for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines&nbsp;and recommend serving configurations&nbsp;suited to individual&nbsp;workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and&nbsp;performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve&nbsp;LLM and VLM&nbsp;endpoint&nbsp;latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server,&nbsp;and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering&nbsp;quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.&nbsp;For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses&nbsp;measuring&nbsp;TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.&nbsp;Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate&nbsp;with GPU kernel and platform engineers to&nbsp;trace&nbsp;bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents,&nbsp;performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong&nbsp;engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer&nbsp;inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference&nbsp;stack,&nbsp;such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or&nbsp;an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong&nbsp;understanding of transformer inference&nbsp;bottlenecks involving&nbsp;KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to&nbsp;quantify trade-offs among&nbsp;latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and&nbsp;cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and&nbsp;collaboration skills across&nbsp;research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or&nbsp;SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or&nbsp;related&nbsp;inference acceleration methods.</li> <li>Experience&nbsp;supporting agentic workloads involving&nbsp;tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects such as&nbsp;vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or&nbsp;KServe.</li> <li>Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.</li> </ul><div The service reports shall include, as a minimum:

  • Progress against agreed project plans, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Status of design, integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and migration activities.
  • Achievement of key project objectives and technical deliverables.
  • Identification of project risks, issues, dependencies, and proposed mitigation actions.
  • Summary of completed activities during the reporting period.
  • Planned activities and milestones for the upcoming reporting period.
  • Status of technical documentation, design artefacts, and acceptance deliverables.
  • Quality assurance activities performed and any identified non-conformities.
  • Resource utilisation and effort expended against assigned tasks, where required.
  • Escalations, decisions, or support required from NCIA stakeholders.

Requirements

Skills, Knowledge & Experience:

  • The candidate must have a currently active NATO SECRET security clearance
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering or a related discipline or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
  • 5 years experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, software engineering, platform engineering or infrastructure automation roles.
  • Experience supporting on-premises CIS environments, including enterprise data centres, mission-critical infrastructure and operational systems.
  • Experience designing, implementing and maintaining DevSecOps pipelines and automation frameworks in secure, on-premises environments.
  • Experience integrating security controls and compliance requirements throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience supporting containerized and cloud-native technologies deployed in on-premises environments.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management and automated deployment solutions.
  • Experience working within military, defence, government or mission-critical operational environments is desirable.
  • Experience producing technical documentation, deployment procedures, architecture diagrams, security artefacts and operational handover documentation.

Expertise/experience in several of the following areas:

  • DevSecOps and CI/CD: Designing, implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. DevSecOps principles and practices, including secure software delivery and automated security testing. CI/CD platforms such as GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps or equivalent. Integrating automated build, testing, deployment and security validation processes.
  • Infrastructure as Code and Automation: Developing and maintaining Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions. Tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet or equivalent. Automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration management and deployment processes. Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar.
  • Containerization and Platform Technologies: Deploying and supporting containerized applications and services. Container technologies such as Docker and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes. Container security, image management and container lifecycle management. Platform engineering concepts and modern application deployment architectures.
  • Cybersecurity and Secure Development: Integrating security controls throughout the software development lifecycle. Secure coding practices, application security principles and software assurance methodologies. Implementing Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA) and vulnerability management processes. Implementing secrets management, identity and access management and secure configuration practices.
  • Systems and Infrastructure: Supporting Linux and Windows Server environments. Virtualization platforms and enterprise infrastructure technologies. Supporting application hosting platforms, middleware, databases and supporting infrastructure services.
  • Monitoring, Logging and Observability: Implementing monitoring, logging and observability solutions. Tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic or equivalent monitoring platforms. Performance monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting and operational reporting.

Certifications

The proposed contractor shall possess at least one of the following certifications:

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate
  • Docker Certified Associate (DCA)
  • Equivalent industry-recognized DevOps, platform engineering or automation certification.

In addition, the contractor shall possess at least one cybersecurity-related certification:

  • CompTIA Security+
  • GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
  • ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • Equivalent industry-recognized cybersecurity certificate

raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

Your impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

What You Will Do

Product Requirements & Roadmap

  • Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

  • Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

  • Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

Partner Lab Onboarding

  • Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

  • Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

  • Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

Closed-Loop Campaigns

  • Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

  • Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

  • Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

  • Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

  • Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

  • Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

  • Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

  • Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

  • Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope).

  • Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration.

  • Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product.

  • Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab.

  • Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries.

Additional Considerations

This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.


CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We actively encourage applications from all backgrounds and value the unique perspectives and contributions that diversity brings to our team.

Please let us know if you require any specific adjustments during or after the interview process. We will do everything we can within reason to accommodate.

Description

Do you have experience managing carrier networks and want to directly impact commercial success? At CtrlChain, we’re looking for a driven Carrier Account Executive to expand and optimize our carrier network across Europe. 

About us 

Over the past eight years, CtrlChain has built a powerful and trusted ecosystem to simplify and modernize the transport and logistics sector. Now, we're making this ecosystem fully available to our customers, both shippers and carriers. 

Our system brings digital transformation to an industry long reliant on outdated processes, offering smart tools that enhance visibility, streamline compliance, and optimize operations. The result? A more efficient, transparent, and effortless way of working for everyone involved! 

We’re growing fast and expanding our carrier network across Europe. As our network grows, the Carrier Team plays a key role in ensuring carriers are onboarded, activated in our systems, and ready to support our commercial growth. 

The role 

As a Carrier Account Executive, you own a portfolio of carriers and play a key role in expanding capacity, improving margins, and supporting Sales in winning new business. 

You actively build and improve the carrier network, ensuring we have the right capacity, performance, and competitiveness to support growth. You play a key role in improving automation, service KPIs, margins, and win-rate. 

What you’ll do 

Build and scale the carrier network 

  • Proactively expand the carrier base for existing and new lanes  
  • Ensure strong capacity coverage aligned with business needs  
  • Identify and onboard new carriers to improve competitiveness  

Drive onboarding & automation 

  • Onboard and activate carriers in CtrlChain systems  
  • Ensure full system adoption and drive a system-first way of working  
  • Increase automation by ensuring carriers use all relevant tools  

Support Sales & improve win-rate 

  • Work closely with Sales on RFPs and new business  
  • Provide competitive carrier solutions and fast turnaround  
  • Contribute directly to improving win-rate  

Optimize performance & margins 

  • Monitor carrier KPIs and proactively drive improvements  
  • Improve service performance (reliability, responsiveness)  
  • Optimize carrier selection to improve margins  

Deliver insights & improve decisions 

  • Ensure carrier data is accurate, complete, and usable  
  • Provide insights to support pricing, planning, and strategy  
  • Identify structural gaps and improvement opportunities in the network 

Requirements

Who You Are 

You’re commercially aware, proactive, and comfortable working at the intersection of operations and Sales. 

You will thrive in this role if you: 

  • Have 5–8 years of experience in transport, freight forwarding, or logistics coordination. 
  • Have experience with carrier onboarding, communication, and daily operations.  
  • Take a proactive approach to expanding carrier capacity on existing and new lanes.  
  • Are comfortable working with KPIs and continuously improving performance (service, responsiveness, reliability).  
  • Have a system-first mindset and ensure tools are used effectively.  
  • Understand how your work impacts Sales win-rate, margins, and competitiveness.  
  • Are structured, responsive, and take ownership.

title: Senior Financial Controller
description: MVRDV zoekt een Senior Financial Controller om ons Finance & Operations team in Rotterdam te versterken. Je bent de financiële rechterhand van onze Head of Finance en de dagelijkse sparringpartner voor Project Managers, Directors en collega's binnen Finance. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in zowel project control als financial control en zorgt ervoor dat financiële informatie betrouwbaar, tijdig en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie. Je ondersteunt Project Managers bij het monitoren en verbeteren van projectresultaten, terwijl je tegelijkertijd bijdraagt aan een hoogwaardige financiële verslaggeving, een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting en een succesvolle accountantscontrole. Met jouw analytische blik, financiële expertise en hands-on mentaliteit lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de verdere professionalisering van onze financiële organisatie. MVRDV is een wereldwijd erkend bureau voor architectuur en stedenbouw, met hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en vestigingen in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. Opgericht in 1993 door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries, ontwerpt MVRDV innovatieve, sociaal verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft. Als collega bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 250 professionals uit meer dan 40 nationaliteiten. Verantwoordelijkheden Project Control Samenwerken met Project Managers bij het opstellen en beoordelen van projectbudgetten, fee-calculaties en forecasts. Financiële projectprestaties monitoren, waaronder omzet, kosten, marge, WIP en cashflow, en risico's en kansen tijdig signaleren. Variantie- en scenarioanalyses uitvoeren en de resultaten vertalen naar praktisch advies over winstgevendheid, facturatie en cashflow. Project Managers ondersteunen bij projectopstart, maandelijkse reviews en projectafsluiting. Zorgen voor een correcte projectopzet, coderingsstructuren en kostentoewijzingen. Urenregistraties en projecttoewijzingen controleren op juistheid en consistentie. Inefficiënties in projectuitvoering signaleren en bijdragen aan margeverbetering. Financial Control Verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie en kwaliteitsbewaking van de financiële verslaggeving en de jaarrekening, inclusief relevante specificaties, balansdossiers en aansluitingen. Verantwoordelijk voor de regie op de jaarlijkse accountantscontrole en de samenwerking met externe accountants, waarbij wordt gezorgd voor een efficiënte en succesvolle afronding van het controleproces. Bewaken van de volledigheid en juistheid van financiële processen, interne beheersingsmaatregelen en financiële gegevens ter ondersteuning van een betrouwbare jaarafsluiting. Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden binnen financiële processen en bijdragen aan verdere professionalisering van de financiële organisatie. Ondersteunen bij maand-, kwartaal- en jaarafsluitingen en zorgen voor betrouwbare financiële rapportages. Business Control & Business Partnering Bijdragen aan bedrijfsbrede budgettering, forecasting en lange termijn planning. Helpen bij het opstellen van managementrapportages, KPI-dashboards en financiële analyses. Projectresultaten verbinden aan de totale financiële prestaties van de organisatie. Projectbudgetten afstemmen op bezetting en capaciteitsplanning. Financiële data vertalen naar heldere, bruikbare adviezen voor niet-financiële collega's. Management ondersteunen bij business cases, scenarioanalyses en besluitvorming. Wie zoeken wij? Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Finance, Bedrijfseconomie, Accountancy of vergelijkbaar. Minimaal 7 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen financial control, business control, accountancy of een vergelijkbare financiële functie. Aantoonbare ervaring met jaarafsluitingen, financiële verslaggeving en jaarrekeningen. Ervaring met accountantscontroles en samenwerking met externe accountants. Ervaring binnen een projectgedreven organisatie, bij voorkeur in architectuur, engineering, consultancy of een vergelijkbare omgeving. Een sterk begrip van financiële rapportage, project accounting en interne beheersing. Gevorderde Excel-vaardigheden en ervaring met ERP- en BI-tools. Vloeiend Engels; Nederlands is een pré. Analytisch, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. In staat financiële vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor niet-financiële stakeholders. Proactief, zelfstandig en gericht op verbetering. Wat bieden wij? Bij MVRDV krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een internationaal, creatief en ondernemend bureau. Je werkt nauw samen met Project Managers, Directors en Financeteam van 5 collega’s en speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere professionalisering van onze organisatie. Wij bieden je: Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie met veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Een internationale werkomgeving met collega's en projecten over de hele wereld. Volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een marktconform salaris conform de cao Architectenbureaus, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 30 vakantiedagen, hybride werken en een inspirerende werkplek in Rotterdam. Onbeperkte toegang tot OpenUp, korting met Urban Sports, een gezonde lunch geserveerd, een NS Business Card en een laptop. Klaar om mee te bouwen aan een financieel sterke toekomst voor MVRDV? description: <p>Are you comfortable navigating complex software systems, working with coding agents, and defining what makes developer tools actually useful? Do you want to shape how developers and AI work together inside IDEs?</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Agentic development is changing how software gets built. Developers no longer just chat with AI – they delegate tasks, run parallel agent sessions, and steer autonomous changes. As agents take on more work, reviewing and owning the output is becoming the hardest part of the process.&nbsp;</p> <p>JetBrains Air is our open system for agentic development. It brings tools like Codex, GitHub Copilot, Claude Agent, Gemini, and Junie directly into JetBrains IDEs, providing an agentic-first user experience.</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead key areas of Air. technical complexity into clear product direction.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Take end-to-end ownership of key parts of Air in JetBrains IDEs, driving work from problem framing and agents and clear perspectives on where current AI tools succeed and fail.</li> <li>Strong product intuition for complex technical user experiences and developer workflows.</li> <li>Clear, concise, and collaborative communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts simply and build alignment across diverse groups of stakeholders.</li> <li>Comfort navigating fast-changing technical landscapes with high ambiguity.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience shipping end-user products as a product manager or in a similar role.</li> closely with software and ML engineers.</li> <li>An understanding of core AI and agent concepts, including tool use, protocols (MCP/ACP), context retrieval, evaluations, and latency/cost trade-offs.</li> <li>The ability to write SQL or Python to analyze product metrics and experiment results independently.</li> <li>Fluency in English, both written and spoken.</li> </ul> across your product roadmap areas.</li> <li>Delivering validated product hypotheses consistently each quarter.</li> <li>Contributing directly to JetBrains AI revenue growth and overall IDE value.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why join JetBrains?</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.</li> <li>Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Full Stack Engineer

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will take primary ownership of our frontend experience while being capable of making the backend changes needed to unblock yourself and your team. You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and stakeholders to deliver scalable, reliable, and high-performance products end-to-end, from pixel to API.

Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam.

What you'll do in this role

  • Design, develop, and maintain frontend components in Angular (and Lit HTML where applicable), ensuring optimal performance, responsiveness, and usability.

  • Own the integration layer between frontend and backend: consume and contribute to OpenAPI-defined APIs, handle data contracts, and wire up microservices cleanly.

  • Make targeted backend changes, new endpoints, tweaks to existing services, minor data model updates, so you can ship features without always depending on a dedicated backend engineer.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions across the full stack, from UI component structure to API design and data access patterns.

  • Participate actively in code reviews, providing feedback on both frontend and backend code quality, adherence to standards, and performance.

  • Mentor and support junior engineers across the stack.

  • Stay current with evolving frontend and full-stack best practices.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years of experience in frontend or full stack engineering.

  • Strong proficiency in Angular and experience with component-based frameworks such as Lit HTML.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, UX/UI principles, and a keen eye for design detail.

  • Proven experience integrating with APIs and microservices, you understand HTTP, REST conventions, auth flows, and error handling deeply.

  • Working proficiency in Python, enough to navigate a FastAPI codebase, add or adjust endpoints, and write Pydantic models and SQLAlchemy queries.

  • Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) at the query and schema level.

  • Experience with containerised workflows using Docker.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills; comfortable working independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work across disciplines.

  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as part of daily workflow.

  • Familiarity with LLM API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and an understanding of the UX patterns specific to AI-powered features.

What success in the first 6 months looks like

  • You've built trust with Backend, DevOps, and Product peers and taken clear ownership of 2–3 frontend domains, including their design system consistency and API integration contracts.

  • You've delivered frontend features end-to-end, from UX design discussion through Angular implementation, API wiring, tests, and documentation, without needing hand-holding at either layer.

  • You've unblocked yourself (and others) by making safe, well-reviewed backend changes: adding an endpoint, adjusting a response model, or optimising a query, rather than waiting in a queue.

  • You've raised frontend quality: responsive across devices, accessible, consistent with our design system, and validated against real API contracts rather than mocks.

  • You've contributed to meaningful observability on the frontend, error tracking, performance budgets, and linked them to backend SLIs where relevant.

  • You've shared knowledge through documentation, code reviews, and mentoring, so the team's frontend capability grows with you.

Current tech stack

We're fully cloud-native on AWS, with a lean, API-first product development approach.

Frontend: Angular · Lit HTML · Headless Wagtail · WordPress

Backend: Python · FastAPI · Pydantic · SQLAlchemy · MySQL · Neo4j

Platform: AWS · Kubernetes · Terraform · Docker · GitHub Actions · ruff · UV · pre-commit · Renovate

Our platform runs on Kubernetes-managed services and Terraform for infrastructure as code. We continue expanding capabilities in knowledge graphs (Neo4j) and modern data access patterns.

What we offer:

  • Impactful work that helps patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. 

  • International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organizational structure that encourages creativity and accountability. 

  • Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and an Employee Stock Option Plan. 

  • Great career development opportunities in a fast-growing company.  

  • Learning and development budget alongside internal knowledge sharing sessions. 

  • Attractive pension plan, full premium covered by myTomorrows. 

  • Hybrid working model. 

  • Policies to support working parents. 

  • Healthy lunch at the thriving Amsterdam office.  

  • Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp  

  • Enjoy monthly events hosted by our vibrant Culture Club as well as an annual ‘myTomorrowland’ company-wide celebration! 

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

description: About the role Every customer's path through DataSnipper, from first sign-up to first agent run to renewal, runs on systems your team owns. We are hiring an Engineering Manager in our Amsterdam office to lead Billing & Monetization : how customers get in, what they are entitled to, and how AI usage turns into revenue. Why DataSnipper? The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empowers those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output must be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand-new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers.
